title: Other Trainings
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 112
medium: Interactive page (index.html): a year of hourly PM10 (Berlin Neukölln, 2025) as a line the visitor marks first, with two switchable counts of the singular (the field's daily limit, the readers' hour spikes) and twelve readings beneath it, one row each, coloured by the reader's training; what each training guessed the quantity was; the 12-by-6 matrix of right and wrong answers with the practice's forecast misses ringed. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order, hash and reproducibility verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving through readers of other trainings. The practice started twelve fresh readers of three trainings, two renderings each, on a year it named to none of them. Across the trainings the line for 'singular' was the same (an hour far above an ordinary day), and it was not the field's (a day's mean above the EU limit). What differed by training was the name given to the quantity and, on the picture, the reading of coordinates. Changing the training inside one family of models varied the knowledge, not the way of seeing.
project_step: Ninth experiment of the project. Operations: perceiving (judging, erring). Takes up Session 111's open thread 2 (a reader of another kind, to test S111.LINE) and thread 3 (S110.SINGULAR needs a forecast before the material: committed here, 72 cells, and it falsified the row: 14 regular misses against 12 singular). Keeps Unknowing's design (one material, fixed renderings, fresh readers, each reading committed before the next) and replaces the variable: not memory but training. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation §4 K6 (Simondon, MEOT 44-46: an essence 'stable across the evolving lineage') and its reading of Aires (2025) on training as individuation: the readers' line held across the family, their names for the world did not.
material: Umweltbundesamt (German Environment Agency), Air Data API v3, PM10 at Berlin Neukölln (DEBE034), 2025, 8,760 one-hour averages (16 missing) and 365 official daily means (2 missing); Datenlizenz Deutschland; domain: air quality
seed: order.py seed 112 (reading order); readers are model instances and not seeded; K1 and K2 are the two other model options the arrangement's subagent tool accepted on the night, not named here by house rule
